description: Notes before #START count toward neither voiceValue nor any judging, so a perfect run from #START earns all 9000; a Note starting exactly at #START is scored
comment: #START 1.0 s is the start of Beat 4. The Note at Beat 0 starts before it and is left out; the Notes at Beats 4 and 6 are scored: voiceValue = 2 + 1 = 3, 3000 per hit Beat. Beats 0 and 1 are not judged even though the Player sang them.
